name: Newhaven, Adventurer's Guild
desc1: This nicely crafted room is well furnished and decorated with things
desc2: that you have never seen before, from strange exotic weapons, to
desc3: swirling vials of liquid. A well toned man, stands in front of a
desc4: practice mat with his arms crossed. He stands up lightly at your
desc5: approach, looks you up and down, and breaks into a lopsided grin.
